notes.title: Yuoni is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
From Japanese studio Tricore Inc and publisher Chorus Worldwide comes Yuoni, a terrifying sunset-stained first-person narrative horror game where you have but three choices: hide, run, or die. 

[b]Yuoni has crept onto Steam today![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39215682/8b2024be78d658f15456f764d089a5f0d0c031d5.png[/img]

You play as Ai, a grade-schooler in 1990s Japan who will soon face her new reality, dragged into a living ghost story where the sun never sets and otherworldly entities hunt her every step of the way. Embrace a deadly game of hide-and-seek as you journey through a tragic tale of friendship, betrayal, and your darkest demons. Escape from the nightmare is determined by your memory, smarts, your ability to hold your breath when hiding, and knowing when to run for your life. 

[b][u]Features[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Weave your way through beautiful, sunset-stained environments in 1990s Japan.
[*] Unravel a chilling horror tale from the perspective of the tough, but vulnerable Ai.
[*] Play a deadly game of hide-and-seek with otherworldly entities.
[*] Learn each spirit’s weakness to survive. Hide, run, or die.
[*] Reach the conclusion to reveal a second path through Yuoni. Slip back into Ai’s horror and face more challenging foes for even greater reward…
[/list]

notes.title: Yuoni Demo Playthrough Livestream with Sephi!
notes.notes:
Yuoni is a first-person narrative horror game that whisks you away to a sunset-stained world to play a deadly game of hide and seek. As grade-schooler Ai, navigate authentic Japanese environments and utilise every hiding space you can find to survive the horrors ahead. And if they find you… run.

Join Sephi from Yuoni's publisher, Chorus Worldwide, as she plays the Yuoni demo and answers some of your questions between screams!

notes.title: Yuoni Demo Update
notes.notes:
Yuoni Demo is updated.

-Fixed the issue that some of the tutorials were not working properly.
-Fixed the issue that some of the key configurations were not working properly.
-Adding function for locking mouse cursor

To enjoy the full experience of the game, we recommend to use a gaming controller. When playing the game with keyboard + mouse, please use Rapid Auto Tap function or the key configuration in the options.

Thanks!
